input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for email disruptor handler, sms disruptor handler, i uuid. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Candidate, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with hello world functionality, so that I can accomplish my hello world-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with demo functionality, so that I can accomplish my demo-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with index functionality, so that I can accomplish my index-related tasks.
